description:
Live search of PubMed, Europe PMC and clinical guidelines.

        Returns up to eight sources for a clinical or research question, each with its study
        type, evidence level and link, usually in about 20 seconds. It does not write an
        answer: cite the sources by number, or use ask_cliniatlas for a full cited answer.
        For an EU medicine's label or SmPC, use lookup_eu_medicine. Do not include patient
        identifiers. Searches are limited per user per day.
name: search_medical_evidence
title: Search medical evidence
